releaseNotes: Added core/adapters/platform-execution.ts, the engine half of the platform-to-engine execution boundary: one read-only CLI that reports a workspace's durable run as typed, stable catalog workflow ids with founder-plain reasons from the digest's own translation table. Exit 0 always means "the engine answered" — including the answer "this workspace is not set up" — so a caller can never mistake an unreachable engine for an empty plan.

The boundary report classifies the raw run statuses the planner files under "waiting on earlier work" (failed, running, orphaned, needs_readback, skipped, not_needed) for what they are. A failed step reported as "upcoming" is a lie to whoever is reading; the platform surface this feeds must not inherit that blind spot.

Submission deliberately stays out of the new CLI: the Formation platform creates or resumes a durable run by invoking core/session/run.ts, the sanctioned runner, so the reducer and the session runner remain the only writers of engine-owned state.
